title: Daniel Bryan vs. The Authority: the Yes Movement
summary: Bryan’s championship breakthrough is immediately taken away. Sustained fan support and a struggle against The Authority lead to two matches in one WrestleMania night.

chapters.title: Bryan wins, then loses the championship
chapters.result: Bryan defeats Cena; Orton cashes in after Triple H attacks Bryan.
chapters.context: The reversal establishes The Authority as an obstacle to Bryan’s title ambitions.

chapters.title: Bryan defeats Triple H
chapters.result: Bryan wins entry into the championship main event.
chapters.context: The first obstacle falls, but Bryan must compete again.

chapters.title: Bryan wins the main event
chapters.result: Bryan defeats Randy Orton and Batista to become WWE World Heavyweight Champion.
chapters.context: The championship win is the central payoff to the Yes Movement’s challenge to authority.
